title: Stability Margins of CBF-QP Safety Filters: Analysis and Synthesis
summary: Control barrier function (CBF)-QP safety filters enforce safety by minimally modifying a nominal controller. While prior work has mainly addressed robustness of safety under uncertainty, robustness of the resulting closed-loop \emph{stability} is much less understood. This issue is important because once the safety filter becomes active, it modifies the nominal dynamics and can reduce stability margins or even destabilize the system, despite preserving safety.
